observed_outcome: Dual bootstrap principals in the same PostgreSQL 18.6 tenant: while principal-b holds an active GET /v1/hud/events stream and receives pre-revocation proj-alpha events, principal-a revokes principal-b access to proj-alpha via POST /v1/hud/grants/revoke. Principal-b receives row.removed for proj-alpha, zero post-revocation events for proj-alpha (including newly committed proj-alpha run.progress payloads), continues receiving proj-beta events, and gets HTTP 403 on previously readable evidence/artifact URLs. Measured propagation latency across n=20 live revocations: p50=16.00ms, p95=31.05ms.
